markdown-it 15.0.3
https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it/releases/tag/15.0.3
https://markdown-it.github.io/markdown-it/

This is the self-contained ESM browser distribution from the published npm
package markdown-it@15.0.3. The only changes are renaming the file to .js and
removing its sourceMappingURL comment (the source map is not shipped).
No CDN requests or npm install are required by Obleth Chat at build/runtime.

Upstream tarball:
https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-15.0.3.tgz
SHA-512 integrity:
sha512-+Az7Ojz3iRGu8KYMvJ6xVhvrxP3eE+vEtJX75Ow88XBpcQNV/0lGX5ZynIIBftREo4DC2jsveAMDaeltmm8QvQ==
Unmodified browser bundle SHA-256:
d5432491790141da046b1197353705db03264f40b5727f3b4b591f5aba193e30

The parser is MIT licensed; see LICENSE. The bundled dependency versions match
the upstream 15.0.3 package-lock.json. Their license notices are included in
DEPENDENCY-LICENSES.txt: mdurl 2.1.0, uc.micro 3.0.0, entities 8.1.0,
linkify-it 6.1.0, and punycode.js 2.3.1.

Update by downloading a reviewed tagged npm release with npm pack
--ignore-scripts, verifying the registry integrity, and replacing its browser
ESM bundle and all license notices. Run tests/markdown.test.mjs after updates.
